Product Goals: Enable users to create professional resumes quickly and easily.
Offer customizable templates to suit various industries and experience levels.
Provide a user-friendly interface accessible on different devices.
User Stories: As a user, I want to be able to easily input my work experience, education, and skills.
As a user, I want to be able to choose from a variety of resume templates.
As a user, I want to be able to download my resume in PDF format.
As a user, I want to be able to customize the font, colors, and layout of my resume.
As a user, I want to be able to access my resume from any device.
Competitive Analysis: Resume.com: Offers a wide range of templates, but the free version is limited.
Canva: Provides visually appealing templates, but may not be suitable for all industries.
Zety: Offers AI-powered resume building, but can be expensive.
Kickresume: Focuses on modern and creative templates, but may not be ideal for traditional industries.
Indeed Resume: Simple and straightforward, but lacks customization options.
MyPerfectResume: User-friendly interface with pre-written phrases, but can feel generic.
VisualCV: Offers resume tracking and analytics, but can be overwhelming for basic users.

Requirement Analysis: The core requirements involve creating a user-friendly interface for inputting resume information, offering a variety of customizable templates, and providing options for downloading the resume in different formats. Key features include text formatting, section ordering, and template selection. The application should be responsive and accessible on different devices. Security and data privacy are also important considerations.
Requirement Pool: User authentication and secure data storage.
Input fields for work experience, education, skills, and other relevant information.
Responsive design for mobile and desktop devices.
UI Design draft: The UI will feature a clean and intuitive design. Users will be guided through a step-by-step process of filling out their resume information. Templates will be displayed in a visually appealing manner, with options for previewing and customizing them. The layout will be responsive, adapting to different screen sizes. The color scheme will be professional and customizable.
Anything UNCLEAR: It's unclear what specific features the user prioritizes. Clarification is needed regarding the target audience (e.g., entry-level, experienced professionals) and any specific industry requirements. Also, what level of customization is expected for the templates?
